_comment: Singapore home-cook recipes for the Meal Plan page. Keyed by a food name in nutrition-db.json. estimatedCost in SGD. In production an AI language model or recipe API would generate these; nutrition still comes from the database, not invented.

recipes.title: Kopitiam Soft-Boiled Eggs
steps: Bring water to a boil, then switch off the heat.
Lower in the eggs and cover for 6 minutes.
Crack into a bowl; season with dark soy and white pepper.

recipes.title: Simple Fried Bee Hoon
steps: Soak the bee hoon in warm water until pliable, then drain.
Stir-fry cabbage and beansprouts in a little oil.
Push aside, scramble the egg, then add the bee hoon and soy sauce.
Toss until evenly coated and heated through.

recipes.title: Roti Prata with Dhal Curry
steps: Warm the dhal curry in a small pot.
Pan-fry the prata over medium heat until golden and crisp on both sides.
Serve hot with the curry for dipping.

recipes.title: Fishball Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 portion noodles (mee pok or bee hoon)
steps: Bring the stock to a boil and poach the fishballs until they float.
Blanch the noodles and vegetables separately.
Assemble in a bowl and pour over the hot soup.
Top with fried shallots and spring onion.

recipes.title: Stir-fried Chap Chye (Mixed Vegetables)
steps: Soak the tang hoon and black fungus until soft.
Fry garlic, then add the harder vegetables first.
Add cabbage, fungus and tang hoon with a splash of water and soy.
Simmer until everything is tender.

recipes.title: Char Siew Rice (leaner cut)
steps: Slice the char siew thinly.
Plate over warm rice with blanched greens and cucumber.
Drizzle with a little dark soy sauce.

recipes.title: Homemade Yong Tau Foo Soup
ingredients: 6 assorted YTF pieces (tofu, fishball, stuffed chilli, ladies' finger)
1 bowl bee hoon or kway teow (optional)
steps: Bring the stock to a gentle boil.
Blanch the YTF pieces until they float, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the leafy vegetables (and noodles) for the last minute.
Ladle into a bowl and top with spring onion and fried shallots.
Serve with chilli and sweet sauce on the side.

recipes.title: Hakka Lei Cha (Thunder Tea Rice)
ingredients: Diced long beans, chye sim and cabbage
Thunder tea paste: basil, mint, coriander, green tea
steps: Blend the herbs and green tea with hot water to make the tea broth.
Stir-fry each diced vegetable and the tofu separately until just cooked.
Arrange the vegetables over brown rice.
Serve with the warm herbal tea to pour over, or on the side.

recipes.title: Hainanese Chicken Rice (lighter, poached)
ingredients: 1 chicken leg (skin removed for fewer calories)
steps: Poach the chicken in gently simmering water with ginger for 25-30 minutes; rest, then slice.
Fry garlic and ginger, add rice and a little chicken stock, cook until fluffy.
Plate rice with sliced chicken and cucumber.
Serve with chilli and dark soy.

recipes.title: Clear Sliced Fish Soup
ingredients: Rice or bee hoon on the side
steps: Simmer the stock with ginger and tomato for 5 minutes.
Add cabbage and cook until soft.
Slide in the fish slices and poach 2-3 minutes until just opaque.
Finish with spring onion; serve with rice or bee hoon.

recipes.title: Nasi Lemak with Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 bowl rice cooked with a splash of coconut milk and pandan
Roasted ikan bilis and peanuts (omit for allergy)
steps: Cook the rice with pandan and a little coconut milk.
Grill (instead of deep-fry) the chicken to cut oil.
Fry or boil the egg.
Plate rice with chicken, egg, cucumber, ikan bilis and a spoon of sambal.

recipes.title: Balanced Cai Fan (economic rice) plate
ingredients: 1 bowl rice (half brown for more fibre)
steps: Steam or grill your protein instead of choosing fried dishes.
Stir-fry two vegetable sides with minimal oil.
Serve over rice; keep the gravy light.
This 1-protein-2-veg plate mirrors a healthier cai fan choice.

recipes.title: White Carrot Cake (less oil)
steps: Pan-fry garlic and chai poh in a little oil.
Add the radish cake cubes and let them char slightly.
Push aside, scramble in the egg, then combine.
Top with spring onion. Skip the sweet sauce to keep it 'white'.

recipes.title: Kopitiam Kaya Toast Set
ingredients: Dark soy sauce and white pepper
steps: Toast the bread and spread kaya and a little butter.
Soft-boil the eggs for about 6 minutes.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, add dark soy and pepper.
Enjoy the toast dipped into the eggs with kopi or teh.
